7466.title: Rejected local host credentials prevent launcher recovery
7466.rootCauseOneLine: The launcher suppresses enrollment when saved auth exists; the daemon has no rejection fallback, so session-open 401 shuts the stack down with unchanged invalid credentials.

prReviews.verdict: STATIC ONLY — direction matches verified cause; runtime correctness unverified
prReviews.topFinding: The open linked PR targets both missing recovery steps; its code and tests were not executed.

7466.proposedFix: Provide authorized local recovery material, dispose a rejected daemon attempt, and re-enroll the same host at most once while preserving remote authentication boundaries.
7466.caveats: Linux real-process reproduction repeated in two clean checkouts. No launchd, unbounded restart loop, CPU measurement, or historical credential invalidation was reproduced. Complete harness and output are inline under reports repository policy.
